p: ye shall destroy their altars: God would have his service pure without idolatrous ceremonies and superstitions. De 12:3.
loved you: Freely, finding no cause in you more than in others so to do.
that the LORD thy God: And so put difference between him and idols.
them that hate him to their: Meaning revealed, or in this life.
mercy which he sware unto thy: This covenant is grounded in his free grace: therefore in recompensing their obedience, he respects his mercy and not their merits.
thine eye shall have no pity: We should not be merciful when God commands severity.
hornet among them: There is not a creature so small, that I will not arm it to fight on your side against them.
beasts of the field increase upon: It is to your advantage that God does not accomplish his promise as soon as you would wish.
be snared therein: And be enticed to idolatry.
